examples: Press Cmd+K, type auth, press Enter: the session auth-refactor opens, wherever it runs.
Press Cmd+K then Enter: back to the session you were on before, like Alt-Tab.
Type @studio :waiting to list only the sessions on studio that wait on you.
Type >restart to restart the session in view; Tab on any session row lists what you can do to it.
how_to: Cmd+K opens it on a Mac, Ctrl+Shift+K elsewhere; Shift+Cmd+P opens it on actions. The same chord closes it, and so does Esc.

An empty box lists recent places, sessions waiting on you and the pages. Typing searches sessions, projects, layouts, dashboards, pages, browser pages, open files, settings, themes and the help sections.
> lists actions; @computer, #project and :state (waiting, working, idle, asleep, blocked, unread) at the start of a word become filters with Tab or Enter; ? searches inside conversations.
Up and Down (or Ctrl+P and Ctrl+N) move, Enter goes, Cmd+Enter pops a session out, Tab opens a row's actions, Cmd+1 to 5 run the first five rows, Backspace in an empty box removes the last filter.

name: Command palette
summary: Press Cmd+K, or the search button on a phone or iPad, and type to jump to any session, project, layout, dashboard, page, browser page, open file, setting, theme or help section, run an action, or search inside conversations.
where: Anywhere in the app: Cmd+K (Ctrl+Shift+K off a Mac).
On a phone or iPad: the search button in the top bar opens it as a full-screen sheet.
